- **Your phone app works again while this app runs.** The headphones accept one controller at a time, so until now the JBL Headphones app on your phone could not connect while this app was open. Now this app connects when you open its panel and lets go 10 seconds after you close it.
- **New setting: Keep always connected** (More settings, off by default). Turn it on to keep the connection all the time, as in 0.1.x. While it is on, the phone app cannot connect.
- **New setting: Battery % in menu bar** (on by default). Shows or hides the percent next to the icon. While the app has let go, it shows the last reading.
- Opening the panel after powering the headphones off from the app now reconnects.
